model: madmom_downbeat RNN ensemble only (front-end removed from ONNX graph)
why: The full-pipeline ONNX (madmom_downbeat_full.onnx) embeds the STFT/framing front-end as opset-17 DFT + dynamic Gather nodes. onnxruntime-android 1.23.0 on a Huawei DNP-AN00 (API 36) SIGSEGVs inside OrtSession.run on that front-end (works on desktop). So the front-end is moved out of the graph into device code (lib/preprocess.dart / gen_features.py); the ONNX graph now contains only the RNN + activation head, which is stable on-device.

ensemble.full: mean of all 8 madmom blstm models (downbeats_blstm_1..8) - exactly madmom DOWNBEATS_BLSTM
ensemble.subset_4x: mean of the first 4 blstm models (downbeats_blstm_1..4)

input.name: features
input.in_graph_reshape: [n_frames, 1, 314] (ONNX LSTM [seq, batch, input]) - done inside the graph
input.per_frame_layout: concat over frame sizes [1024, 2048, 4096], in that fixed order, each as [log10-filterbank(1+x) columns then positive-diff columns] => per size [n_bands log | n_bands diff]
input.note: 2 * 157 = 314 columns. Exact row order = the concatenation the full ONNX graph produced internally, so feeding these features reproduces the same RNN output.

feature_generation.pcm_source: 44100 Hz mono float32 in [-1, 1] (madmom int16/32768 convention). Front-end is NOT in the graph - device must compute features from PCM.
feature_generation.python_reference: gen_features.py (conda env beat-proto-c) -> my_preproc in preproc_ref.py, aligned to madmom RNNDownBeatProcessor front-end to ~1e-7.
feature_generation.dart: lib/preprocess.dart, validated against gen_features.py by tool/preprocess_check.dart (target max feature err < 1e-3; log-domain differences acceptable if RNN activations track madmom).
feature_generation.stft: radix-2 FFT per frame. Hanning windows, frame sizes 1024/2048/4096, hop 441 (100 fps), zero-padded centered framing origin=0 (frame t = samples [t*441 - size/2 ... +size/2)), boundary zero-fill. Use f32 log-domain tolerance ~1e-5/1e-3.

graph.content: 8x (3-layer bidirectional LSTM H=25 with peephole P as native ONNX LSTM + FF 50->3 + Softmax + drop non-beat column), then ReduceMean -> [n,2]. Identical nodes/weights to the RNN part of madmom_downbeat_full.onnx.

validation.method: features from gen_features.py -> pure RNN onnx; compare to madmom RNNDownBeatProcessor full chain and to madmom_downbeat_full.onnx fed raw PCM
